mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 115 and UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 190), reduced liquidity and higher real interest rates depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 190, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 thousand units indicate weakening consumer demand for housing, reducing household spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 2000, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals manufacturing output contraction, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 115, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 340,000 million dollars reflects strong consumer demand for housing, boosting household income and spending, which generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 340,000, the S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Employment level (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand persons indicates labor market strength, increasing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is above 130,000, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
